rag_usage_hints: Apollo Kotlin 3.8.2 uses group com.apollographql.apollo3 (not com.apollographql.apollo).
Prefer ApolloClient.Builder().networkTransport(QueueTestNetworkTransport()).build() for ordered JVM unit tests.
Call client.enqueueTestResponse(operation, data) before CUT execute(); use enqueueTestNetworkError() for transport failures.
Do not stub ApolloClient.query()/mutation() with Mockito thenThrow — enqueue on the test transport instead.
Suspend execute() should run inside kotlinx.coroutines.test runTest { }.
Generated Operation types come from SOURCE (e.g. your.app.api); never invent Query/Mutation classes or Read build/generated.

If the module already provides harness wrappers (mockApollo, QueueNetworkTransport.enqueueThrow, apolloHttp), prefer those only when present in-module; otherwise use official apollo-testing-support APIs.
Tear down with client.close() or client.dispose() in @After when the client is test-owned.

test_generation_capabilities.notes: Confirmed against apollo-kotlin v3.8.2 testing-support sources and handler tests.
Use when the same operation may be executed multiple times with a stable fixture.
